subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. Above water, a small gap between wind-driven clouds reveals the jagged twin ridges and high blue-green interior of Tahiti several miles to windward. Slanting morning light and low cloud hide much of the shore. Open ocean fills foreground.
